value.title: Fixed-pair continuous-certificate BSSC upper bound
value.summary:
Assume the cited Gohari--Liu--Nair Theorem 9 outer-bound premise exactly as stated in the sole declared dependency. For the half-skew BSSC, fix binary auxiliary receivers with P(G=0|X=0)=0.206961624915382, P(G=0|X=1)=0.826953249115544, P(K=0|X=0)=0.173046750884456, and P(K=0|X=1)=0.793038375084618, treating every displayed decimal as exact. The dependency's premise-bound private-message rows and the included exact-rational plus directed-interval weak-duality certificate prove C_sum <= U with U in [0.36929694596920284244271335135600317726937686320586339865039784778686683932875798, 0.36929694596920284244271335135600317726937686320586339865039784778686683932875818], and hence C_sum <= 0.369296945969202842443. This claim concerns only this fixed receiver pair and dual certificate; it does not authenticate or re-prove the cited theorem premise and does not assert receiver or dual optimality, a matching achievable rate, or the exact BSSC sum-capacity.

Scope qualifications:
- The result is conditional on the declared dependency’s transcription of the external Theorem 9 premise; the external theorem and its transcription are not independently authenticated or re-proved.
- The dependency is needed only for the outer-bound interface and the assertion that the six inequalities constrain every achievable private-message rate pair for the fixed receivers; its broader product-marginal reduction, Q0 discussion, and provenance material are unnecessary.
- The certificate applies only to the specified fixed auxiliary receiver pair, with every displayed decimal treated as exact.
- No receiver optimality, dual optimality, matching achievable rate, or exact BSSC sum-capacity is established.
- The proof uses weak duality over the full continuous posterior domain and all input priors; it does not rely on strong duality, attainment, minimax interchange, or a sampled grid.

value.title: Continuous weak-duality proof for the fixed auxiliary-receiver pair
value.summary: Proof record bounded to `root/result/fixed-pair-upper-bound-attested`. Starting from six identified rows of the required premise-bound Theorem 9 specialization, the proof forms a nonnegative weighted combination whose exact rate coefficients are one, rewrites the information terms using posterior mutual-information identities and martingale common-mean relations, and reduces the resulting expression to three posterior groups. Affine inner and outer lines then give a weak-duality bound over the complete posterior interval. Exact curvature and ordering checks cover the analytic tangent and endpoint regions; fail-closed directed interval subdivision covers the remaining continuous regions. An exact tensor audit cancels the auxiliary-receiver prior terms and yields a concave reflection-symmetric prior bound whose global maximum occurs at the fair prior. This proof establishes only the accepted fixed-pair conditional upper bound and does not authenticate the external theorem premise or establish receiver optimality, dual optimality, achievability, or exact capacity.
